facilities.name: Mary L. Stephens Davis Branch Library
facilities.detail: Public computers, Wi-Fi and printing. No charging, cooling or shelter activation is assumed.

visit.hours: Mon noon–8pm; Tue–Thu 9:30am–8pm; Fri–Sat 9:30am–5:30pm; Sun 1–5:30pm. Check the branch calendar for closures.
visit.cost: Printing/copying have charges; check branch rates.
visit.activation: Routine service; no incident-specific activation verified.

facilities.name: Davis Community Clinic
facilities.detail: Primary, behavioral, perinatal and dental care. Community clinic, not a hospital emergency department.

visit.hours: Primary/behavioral care Mon–Fri 8am–5pm; Mon/Thu evenings until 9pm. Other departments have different hours.
visit.eligibility: Contact the provider about appointments, enrollment and the service needed.
visit.cost: Confirm fees, insurance and financial assistance with the provider.
visit.activation: Routine service; no incident-specific activation verified.

facilities.name: Legal Services of Northern California — Woodland
facilities.detail: Civil legal assistance for low-income Yolo County clients, including housing and benefits.

visit.hours: New intake Mon–Thu 8:30am–noon and 1–3pm; no new intake Friday. Existing-client hours differ.
visit.eligibility: Low-income Yolo County clients; eligibility and case acceptance must be checked.
visit.accessibility: Provider requests contact for specific accommodations; online intake is an alternative to telephone contact.
visit.activation: Routine service; no incident-specific activation verified.

facilities.name: D Street Resource Center
facilities.detail: Public intake, food distribution and a restricted clothing closet. Public resource office, not a confidential shelter address.

visit.eligibility: Appointments encouraged. Programs and clothing access have their own intake requirements.
visit.activation: Routine service; no incident-specific activation verified.

visit.eligibility: Appointments encouraged; confirm distribution schedule and program eligibility.

facilities.detail: Routine adult overnight shelter and daytime meals, showers and laundry. Not an activated disaster shelter.

visit.hours: Shelter program operates year-round; confirm current admission and day-service times.
visit.eligibility: Adult shelter intake; families should ask about separate family programs. Admission and space are unconfirmed.

dcmh-meals.detail: Prepared community meals at St. Martin’s. Meal site, not an emergency shelter.

visit.hours: Tue 5:45–6:30pm; Thu 5:30–6:30pm; Sat 11:30am–12:15pm. No meals July 4 or Christmas; check holiday changes.
visit.activation: Routine service; no incident-specific activation verified.

dcmh-center.detail: Daytime food, showers, clothing, laundry, hygiene supplies and in-person help. Not an overnight or activated disaster shelter.

visit.eligibility: Unhoused and low-income individuals and families; provider encourages an in-person visit.
visit.activation: Routine service; no incident-specific activation verified.
